decisions.title: The Lead Owns Coordination
decisions.description: The lead agent decides when to spawn teammates, what to send them, and how to interpret replies. Teammates can work independently, but the user-facing conversation stays anchored in one lead loop.
decisions.alternatives: A peer-to-peer team would be more flexible, but much harder to explain because no single loop owns the answer.

zh.title: 由 Lead Agent 负责协调
zh.description: Lead agent 决定何时创建队友、发送什么任务、如何解释回复。队友可以独立工作，但面向用户的对话始终锚定在一个 lead 循环中。

decisions.title: Mailboxes Make Team Communication Inspectable
decisions.description: MessageBus writes JSONL mailboxes so every handoff is visible on disk. This avoids magical shared memory and gives learners a concrete artifact for debugging team behavior.
decisions.alternatives: In-memory channels are faster, but they hide the communication history and disappear when the process stops.

zh.title: 邮箱文件让团队通信可检查
zh.description: MessageBus 使用 JSONL 邮箱记录每次交接。这样避免了神秘的共享内存，也给学习者一个能直接调试团队行为的具体文件。

decisions.title: Teammates Use Scoped Tool Sets
decisions.description: A teammate loop receives a narrower prompt and tool set than the lead. That keeps delegation focused and prevents a helper agent from accidentally taking over orchestration.
decisions.alternatives: Giving every teammate the full tool pool is simpler, but it blurs roles and makes failures harder to attribute.

zh.title: 队友使用受限工具集
zh.description: 队友循环拿到比 lead 更窄的提示词和工具集。这样委派更聚焦，也避免 helper agent 意外接管整体协调。
